items.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 18 at 4:11AM AKST until November 18 at 9:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 45 to 55 mph with gusts up to 75 mph.

* WHERE...Pribilof Islands.

* WHEN...Until 9 AM AKST this morning.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds gusting to 75 mph early this morning for
both St. Paul and St. George. As a result of the long duration of
westerly winds, wave heights of 25 to 30 ft within 15 to 20
nautical miles of Saint Paul are expected through Wednes
items.instruction:
People are urged to secure loose objects that could be blown around
or damaged by the wind. Prepare for the possibility of widespread
power outages. Use caution if you must drive.

items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 18 at 1:58AM AKST until November 19 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 4 to 6 feet above the normal high tide

* WHEN...From 3 AM Wednesday to 3 PM AKST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding is expected. In Nome, water
will approach homes in the Belmont Subdivision, portions of
the port area will have standing water, and wave run-up will
push water much higher than normal. In Golovin, water will
approach beach property.

* ADDITIONAL
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
